entities.name: Avatar
entities.description: Image-or-initials avatar with deterministic hue from name. A broken/missing src falls back to the initials render. It never shrinks in a flex row (shrink-0): beside a long name that truncates, a logo squeezed into a sliver reads as broken; a caller's class can still override it. Also exported as EntityLogo (same component) for the company/entity-mark call site, as distinct from a person avatar.

props.name: shape
props.description: square is the rounded tile EntityLogo uses; circle is the person avatar.

props.name: fallbackIcon
props.description: Shown only when there is neither src nor name.

entities.name: EntityLogo
entities.description: Same implementation as Avatar (src/avatar.svelte), exported under a second name for the company/entity-mark call site — a rounded-square tile, as distinct from Avatar's circular person default. It never shrinks in a flex row (shrink-0): beside a long name that truncates, a logo squeezed into a sliver reads as broken; a caller's class can still override it.

props.name: shape
props.description: Call sites for an entity mark pass square explicitly.

props.name: fallbackIcon
props.description: Shown only when there is neither src nor name — e.g. a Globe icon for a company with no resolvable logo or name.

entities.name: EmptyState
entities.description: Empty-result placeholder with optional icon, description, and action slot.

entities.name: Pager
entities.description: Prev/next stepper over a bound page, in local state only — no URL, no links. A crawlable listing wants the app's own Pagination component instead.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered between the prev and next controls, in place of the default page count.

entities.name: FormField
entities.description: Label + error + hint wrapper with auto-generated id and required indicator.

props.name: children
props.type: Snippet<[{ id: string; describedBy: string | undefined; required: boolean; invalid: boolean }]>
props.description: The field owns the label and the message and hands the control everything it needs to announce itself — render it as {@render children({ id, describedBy, required, invalid })}.

entities.name: Table
entities.description: Styled table with slots for thead/tbody/tr/th/td.

entities.name: SectionLabel
entities.description: Quiet sentence-case label that heads a page section (medium weight, normal tracking, muted). Callers pass the bare section name; `as` makes it a heading where it is the section's only title.

props.name: as
props.description: The element. A heading where the label is the section's only title.

entities.name: ProviderIcon
entities.description: Inlined OAuth/brand SVG marks (Google keeps its official colours; the rest follow currentColor so they adapt to the theme).

entities.name: NumberedGrid
entities.description: Numbered hairline grid for "01 / 02 / 03" landing-page blocks — cells sit on a bg-border grid with gap-px so the 1px gaps read as hairline rules.

props.name: items
props.type: { n: string; title: string; body: string }[]

entities.name: SettingRow
entities.description: One settings line: label (+ optional hint) on the left, an arbitrary control on the right. grow lets a variable-width control (e.g. a font-name select) take the spare space instead of truncating the label.

entities.name: TabStrip
entities.description: Tab icons are hidden below `sm`, so a phone strip shows labels only. Horizontally-scrolling, fade-masked underline tab strip with roving-tabindex arrow-key navigation. A tab carrying an href renders as an anchor (so a strip of routes stays middle-clickable and openable in a new tab) and then the arrows move focus only, since activating a link navigates. Distinct from Tabs (a pill/segmented control with no overflow handling) — for a row that can outgrow its container. Screen-reader attention labels stay contained within the scrolling strip, avoiding page overflow on narrow screens. Also exports the tabStripId(panelId, tab) helper.

props.name: tabs
props.type: readonly { id: T; label: string; icon?: LucideIcon; href?: string; attention?: string }[]
props.description: attention puts a quiet brand dot after the label (something on that tab still wants the reader); the string is what a screen reader hears in its place.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Commits a selection. Unused by a strip of href tabs — there the navigation is the selection.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the strip for assistive tech, e.g. "Profile sections".

props.name: panelId
props.description: id of the role="tabpanel" element these tabs drive.

entities.name: LoadMore
entities.description: A Button composition for paginated lists: a loading label + disabled state, and an optional error line below.

entities.name: CountryFlag
entities.description: Round country flag backed by the flag-icons sheet (a caller-owned dependency — see the story for how it loads the sheet). Falls back to the plain upper-cased code when it is not a renderable two-letter code.

props.name: code
props.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any case.

props.name: label
props.description: The country's display name — resolved by the caller (e.g. #lib/facets' countryLabel), not by this primitive.

entities.name: BrandMark
entities.description: A brand's logo glyph, drawn from its own SVG path + hex color — always renders in that brand color, flat on the page (not on a colored badge, unlike ProviderIcon's fixed OAuth switch). The caller supplies the path/hex/title (e.g. the app's own techmarks.ts, sourced from simple-icons); this primitive takes no icon-set dependency itself.

props.name: path
props.description: SVG path data, drawn in a 0 0 24 24 viewBox.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name, set as the svg's aria-label.

entities.name: Breadcrumbs
entities.description: Visible trail back to the page a detail page sits under: a hub link per level, then the current page bold and unlinked.

props.name: items
props.description: Each item is { name, href? } — an item without href renders as the current page (bold, aria-current="page").
